statusDefinitions.fixed_and_verified: The correction is integrated and current repository evidence verifies the claimed scope.
statusDefinitions.partially_remediated: Material safeguards or wording corrections are integrated, but a stated part of the finding remains open.
statusDefinitions.corrected_outdated_snapshot: The dated observation no longer describes current state; current facts and their evidence are published separately.
statusDefinitions.governance_or_future_version_gated: The remaining change needs an authorized governance action, migration or separately reviewed future contract version.
statusDefinitions.documented_accepted_or_monitored: The current limitation is explicitly documented and monitored; it must be revisited before the affected path is activated or replaced.
statusDefinitions.open_actionable: Repository, hosting or product work remains directly actionable.

findings.title: Project-wide legal, privacy and risk disclosures
findings.currentAssessment: Benefits now has a dedicated privacy surface and public claims carry narrower risk boundaries, but project-wide operator, privacy, terms and regulatory texts still require qualified German/EU legal review.
findings.remainingAction: Complete qualified legal review and publish only the approved project-wide disclosures; keep lending fail-closed until its legal and technical activation gates are satisfied.
findings.verification: Legal approval, route/link checks on every public surface and a privacy data-flow review.

findings.title: Unqualified lifetime-access marketing
findings.currentAssessment: Active core copy now states that access remains active only while each product's required IFR stays locked and the integration remains available.
findings.remainingAction: Keep the content-trust guard and review new product copy against the same qualified-access rule.
findings.verification: Content-trust test plus public Landing/Wiki claim checks.

evidence.marker: access remains active while each product's required IFR stays locked and that integration remains available

findings.title: LendingVault manual price and activation risk
findings.currentAssessment: V1 borrowing remains fail-closed with ifrPriceWei = 0. Lender offers are live, but borrower activation is not approved and requires a bounded, fresh, pausable price path.
findings.remainingAction: Design and independently review the V2 price path, caps, expiry behavior and emergency controls before any governed activation.
findings.verification: Oracle freshness/bounds tests, hostile-price tests, independent review, governance execution and post-execution chain checks.

findings.title: Internal reviews presented as an external audit
findings.currentAssessment: Current public copy distinguishes internal audits, community reviews and automated evidence from an independent professional certification, which remains pending.
findings.remainingAction: Preserve the wording guard and do not use professional-certification language until a qualifying audit exists.
findings.verification: Content-trust test and Landing/Wiki/Copilot claim checks.

evidence.marker: These are internal audits, not an independent professional certification.
a professional third-party audit remains a planned security milestone

findings.title: Dated adoption, liquidity and live-state snapshot
findings.currentAssessment: The original zero-offer and zero-lock statements are historical. Current public status records live CommitmentVault locks and three LendingVault offers while still disclosing that borrowing is disabled and adoption remains limited.
findings.remainingAction: Continue dated, source-labeled live-state reporting and never convert snapshots into evergreen adoption claims.
findings.verification: Block-pinned chain reads, current status tests and stale-data behavior on live surfaces.

findings.title: Guardian and signer centralization
findings.currentAssessment: Safe ownership and timelock controls are public, but guardian concentration and signer independence remain governance/key-custody questions rather than completed remediations.
findings.remainingAction: Approve and execute a reviewed guardian/key-custody model or explicitly accept the current model with bounded operational controls.
findings.verification: Role inventory, proposal simulation, signer/key separation evidence and post-execution chain checks.

evidence.marker: Guardian powers are concentrated in one EOA

findings.title: Vault fee-exemption solvency dependency

findings.remainingAction: Keep invariant monitoring active and implement runtime exemption checks plus balance-diff accounting in a separately reviewed V2.
findings.verification: Scheduled chain monitor, negative exemption tests and future V2 deposit/withdraw lifecycle tests.

evidence.marker: Monitoring and negative tests implemented; V2 hardening remains future work

findings.title: Governance execute, expiry and minimum-delay design
findings.currentAssessment: Deployed Governance keeps owner-only execute, no proposal expiry and a one-hour contract minimum while the live configured delay is documented as 48 hours. Changing immutable design requires a reviewed redeploy/migration.
findings.remainingAction: Bundle permissionless execution, proposal expiry and delay-floor decisions into the planned Governance replacement and migration review.
findings.verification: Governance lifecycle tests, migration simulation, independent review and governed deployment evidence.
